name: schoolride
description: SchoolRide parent app: HTML/CSS/JS prototype (source of truth for UX before the React Native port).

scripts.setup: npm install && npx playwright install chromium
scripts.build:mobile-web: cd mobile && bash -c 'unset npm_config_prefix; . "$HOME/.config/nvm/nvm.sh" && nvm use >/dev/null && npx expo export --platform web --output-dir dist-web'
